belief_update: I am unstable, and that is why I can't be trusted with students or my family. If anyone found out, they would see me as weak and unreliable, and I would lose every chance of being respected. I hide everything because I know what they would think if they saw me struggle. I am not like other teachers who seem to handle stress without breaking down; I am fundamentally different, and that is just how it is. I don't let anyone see how bad it gets because I don't want them to think I'm not capable of being a father or a teacher. I believe I am failing at the most basic level of competence, and there is no way to prove otherwise.
